# DSH Rust (dsh-rust) — Agent Harness

> A contract-first Rust implementation of DeepSeek Harness.
> Cargo workspace with domain ports, use cases, HTTP/SSE constants and an in-memory adapter.

Key capabilities (v0.1.0 skeleton):
- Contract-first workspace: `contracts/v1` schemas mirrored by `dsh-types`
- Layered crates: types -> domain <- case -> http/infra
- Types: `ContentBlock` (text), `ToolDescriptor` + `JsonSchema`, typed IDs (`agent-`, `sess-`, …), `Error`/`ErrorCode`
- Session aggregate and `SessionRepository` port with in-memory implementation
- Run-request validation (blank text rejected with `invalid_request`)
- HTTP/SSE route constants fixed ahead of the server
- Runnable `dsh-runtime` entry that self-checks wiring
- Quality gates: rustfmt, clippy `-D warnings`, unit tests, contract schema validation

Tech stack: Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, Cargo workspace, Node.js 20 (contract tooling)
Version: 0.1.0
Contract version: 1.0.0-draft.1
Upstream: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
Java counterpart: https://github.com/linlannet/dsh-java

Build: `cargo build --workspace`
Test:  `cargo test --workspace`
Run:   `cargo run -p dsh-runtime`
Lint:  `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
Contracts: `node contracts/tools/validate.mjs`

Crate map:
- crates/dsh-types   contract value objects, IDs, error model
- crates/dsh-domain  session aggregate, ports
- crates/dsh-case    use cases and request validation
- crates/dsh-http    HTTP/SSE route and event constants
- crates/dsh-infra   adapters (in-memory session repository)
- apps/dsh-runtime   executable entry with self-check
- contracts/         v1 schemas, fixtures, policy, tools

Docs:
- README.md / README.en.md
- docs/0.1.0/ (spec, design, tasks, release notes)
- contracts/README.md
- AGENTS.md

Not included yet: HTTP server, model calls, ReAct loop, plugin host, persistence, approvals, tool execution.
